# story-rule-consistency

Adopted story exit and UI admission. The requirements inventory is the denominator
for high-risk rules. Each rule states condition, action, effect, UI/API-defense
channel, reachability, failure applicability and boundary examples. A blocked UI
selection and API defensive rejection may coexist. Conflicts need an effective
decision; arbitrary prose/formula equivalence requires an input-bound semantic
review with sources, rationale and examples. No regexp proves equivalence.
Errors: RULE_CONFLICT_OPEN, UI_PATH_UNREACHABLE, RULE_EXAMPLE_MISMATCH,
RULE_FAILURE_UNDEFINED. Definitions/copies are handled by the shared story parser.
